outcome: Income detail · October: Finance reviews the prepared income schedule, returns it for correction or approves it, in four states (contract mock only)
acceptance_criteria: **Four states from data.** `/work/W-2701`…`W-2704` show the status label and tone, stations, sections, agent card, quote, facts and "Next" of their fixture and nothing else; no board string is in `src` (`grep -rn "CHIDI INVESTIGATING\|AWAITING FINANCE DECISION\|CORRECT AND RESUBMIT\|THESE 38 ROWS\|Service revenue" frontend/src` returns nothing). — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/income-schedule.test.tsx`; pages at 1440 and 390.

**Amounts as returned.** On W-2702 the report line reads "₦12,400,000.00" at 1440 and at 390 (no "₦12.4M"); changing the fixture's amount to `"12400000.10"` shows "₦12,400,000.10" exactly. — verify: component test at both widths.

**The page computes nothing.** Changing W-2701's figure values (e.g. "31 ROWS" to "30 ROWS") leaves the section title "Income detail · 38 rows" unchanged; changing W-2702's "2 OF 2" or W-2704's `next` text changes only that text; no new or changed file under `frontend/src/features/workspace/` adds `parseFloat`, `Number(`, `reduce(`, `compactAmount` or arithmetic on an amount or count. — verify: component tests on modified copies; `git diff -U0 frontend/src | grep -nE "parseFloat|Number\(|\.reduce\(|compactAmount"` returns nothing.

**Unknown is never 0, blank or a dash.** W-2707 shows "Unknown" for the report line and for Detail rows; the page contains no "₦0", no "0.00", no empty value cell and no "-" or "—" in their place. — verify: component test on W-2707.
**Sample-marked.** Every fixture page shows the shared `SampleLabel` ("SAMPLE DATA") because the record says `sample: true`; a copy with `sample: false` does not. — verify: component test.

**Reviewer not set is a hold.** W-2706 shows the backend's status, the "Who reviews schedules · NOT SET" fact and its `next` sentence; there is no Decide panel, no button, no claim or decide request, and no reviewer's name or role anywhere on the page. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch` (zero POSTs); `document.body.textContent` checked for "Ada Okafor" and "Schedules reviewer" (absent).

**Decide controls only from `you_can_act` and the steps.** W-2702 shows "Approve schedule", "Return with a note" and "Reject" under "Decide · Schedules reviewer"; W-2709 shows only Approve and Return; W-2711 shows neither the `revoke` nor the `post` step; W-2710 draws its step as the existing link (the step's own label) to `/work/W-2710/decide?task=T-2710`. W-2705 shows "You prepared Schedule v1, so someone else must review it." and W-2708 the `not_your_role` copy, each with no button and no claim sent. The same pages for personas `finance_lead`, `ceo` and `pm` draw the same controls; the new code does not read `/me` (`grep -rn "useMe\|/me\b" frontend/src/features/workspace/InlineDecide.tsx` returns nothing). — verify: component tests with three personas and a recording `fetch`.

**Agent work is not a decision.** On W-2701 Chidi's steps, sources, "WORKING" and "CHIDI CHECKING" render in the agent style; there is no decide control; the possible duplicates are never shown as "none" or "no duplicates"; "Ask Chidi" links to `/assistant`. — verify: component test; link href.

**Verified only when the response says so.** W-2704 shows "VERIFIED" from its status; pressing Approve on W-2702 shows "Verified" only after the re-read serves `W-2702.approve.json` (`state: verified`); with the decide answering 200 but the re-read still serving the review state (test double), the page does not say "Verified". "Posted to the ledger: NO" and "THESE 38 ROWS ONLY" come from `facts`; W-2704 has no Export or Withdraw button. — verify: component tests with a recording `fetch`.

**Approve.** On W-2702, the page sends one E-TASK-CLAIM to `/api/v1/tasks/T-2702/claim`, then pressing "Approve schedule" sends exactly one POST `/api/v1/tasks/T-2702/decision` with the CSRF header and `{verdict: "approve", expected_revision: 1}` (validates against the generated request schema, no note, no extra keys); a double press sends one. — verify: component test; e2e request log.

**Return and reject need a note.** Pressing "Return with a note" or "Reject" with an empty or blank note sends nothing and shows the note message under the field, announced, with focus on it; a note over 2000 characters is refused before sending. With a note, one POST with `verdict: "return"` (or `"reject"`) and the trimmed note; the re-read shows the returned (or rejected) state. — verify: component tests; e2e request log shows no decision POST without a note.
**No write when the person cannot act.** On W-2705, W-2706 and W-2708 no claim and no decision is sent, whatever is pressed or typed. — verify: e2e request log (zero task POSTs).

**Backend refusals are shown.** With `psl_mock_scenario` 403 the decide shows the read-only view and no "approved"; 409 shows the stale view, keeps the note and sends again only on a new press with the new revision; 422 shows the message under the note. — verify: component tests; `tests/income-schedule-mock.test.ts`.

**Uncertain decide.** A network failure, timeout or 500 on decide re-reads the item before anything else, shows `UncertainNotice`, never shows "approved", "returned" or "rejected" from the click, and sends no second decision automatically. — verify: component test with fake timers (one POST after 60 s); e2e with a routed abort.

**Correct and resubmit.** On W-2703 (and on `W-2702` after a return), "Correct and resubmit" opens the step form with "Row 12 relationship" as a required choice of three with nothing selected; submitting without a choice sends nothing and shows the field message; with a choice, one POST `/api/v1/work/W-2703/steps` with CSRF, `expected_revision`, `step: "correct_and_resubmit"`, `inputs.row_12_relationship` one of the options, and a UUID `idempotency_key`; a retry after a 500 reuses the same key; on 200 the re-read shows the item back in review with the `prepared_by_you` copy. The page never says "resubmitted" before the re-read. — verify: component tests; e2e request log.

**No D-RETURN wording of our own.** The returned page shows the reviewer's quote and the step's `consequence` as returned and no "Proposal: every return…" note (absent from the fixture); `grep -rn "backend only waits\|every return" frontend/src` returns nothing. — verify: grep; component test.

**Access.** 401 on read or write → signed-out with `next=/work/<id>`; 403 and 404 on read look the same and show no title, amount or fact; persona `none` gets the same not-open view with no further call. — verify: component tests with a recording `fetch`.

**Phone.** At 390 each state is one column with the same sections, words and values as desktop; the Decide bar is pinned with the three step labels; "Return with a note", "Reject" and "Correct and resubmit" open the full-height `Drawer` with the note or the field; Escape and Cancel close it and return focus to the button; no sideways scroll; every button, link, tab and segment is at least 44 by 44 px (D-92c; links inside sentences exempt, D-95). — verify: e2e at 390 measuring bounding boxes.

**Fidelity (D-64, D-83).** One design-fidelity run per round over the 8 boards on a production build at `--width 1440` and `--width 390`; every board's element coverage after approved exceptions is 100%; visual is at least 90, or a board-level waiver citing D-83 in `fidelity-exceptions.json` with visual at least 70 (lower only with a signed one-board floor exception); every exception has `role`, `name`, `category`, `reason`, `approved_by` and maps to a Conflicts number; none covers a value the data can supply (an amount, a name, a date, a tag, a count, a sentence). The UI reviewer's side-by-side reading finds no fixable gap. — verify: the fidelity command per board; `round-<N>/fidelity/scores.txt`.

**Accessibility.** No axe violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`) at 1440 and 390 on W-2701…W-2706, the open Drawer, the note error, the uncertain notice and the not-open view; every field labelled; errors announced; status words in text, not colour only; visible focus; the agent pulse does not animate under `reducedMotion: 'reduce'`. — verify: `e2e/income-schedule.spec.ts`.

**Tokens and components only.** The diff adds no `#hex`, `rgb(`, `hsl(` or raw px outside tokens in `features/workspace/*.css`, and no local copy of a component `@/components` exports (`Button`, `Drawer`, `TextArea`, `Callout`, `Panel`, `Tag`, `Segmented`). — verify: grep on the diff.

**Mock matches the contract.** `tests/income-schedule-mock.test.ts`: every new fixture and sidecar validates against the generated E-WORK-ITEM schema with `steps[].verdict` stripped; claim then approve on W-2702 serves `W-2702.approve.json`; return without a note is 422; a stale revision is 409; W-2705's decide is 403; the W-2703 step serves `W-2703.next.json`; reset clears. — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/income-schedule.test.tsx tests/income-schedule-mock.test.ts tests/mock-contract.test.ts`.

**Contract not extended.** `git diff --stat` shows no change in `frontend/src/api/**`, `frontend/src/features/decide/**`, `frontend/src/shell/**`, `frontend/mock/server.mjs`, `frontend/mock/workspace.mjs`, `frontend/mock/fixtures/response/**`, `frontend/mock/fixtures/finance/**`, `E-MONTH-END.json`, any existing fixture, `apps/**`, `architecture/**`, `design/**` or the protected paths; every overlay field is listed as a contract proposal in build.md. — verify: `git diff --stat`; build.md.

**Existing tests green.** `delivery/checks.sh` passes, and the tests listed under Context pass unchanged, including `tests/response-mock.test.ts` (W-1603 reconcile) and the month-end link assertions. — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`; `cd frontend && npx vitest run` and the e2e command under Lanes, pasted in build.md.

**build.md evidence.** Commands and results, the 8 scores and waivers, every exception with its Conflicts number, every proposal and backend item, the held list from "What is sent", and the mock-seam choice (option (b)). — verify: file content.

risk.rationale: High, because this is a Finance approval over money. A reviewer approves the October income detail (₦12,400,000.00 service revenue), and a wrong control would let a Finance figure look approved or verified without the human decision. The rules the product forbids most are at stake here: unknown shown as zero, a frontend-computed figure, an invented approver, an agent claim read as verified. The work is contained: a view on the F-17 frame with the existing E-TASK-DECIDE and E-WORK-STEP writes, on the mock, with nothing posted. SURFACES: ui (8 boards); api (E-WORK-ITEM, E-TASK-CLAIM/DECIDE, E-WORK-STEP); security (an authority-bearing approval write with CSRF, revision, idempotency and separation of duties, so it gets a security review); contract-change (G-C-1, G-C-2, G-54-3 and the `income_schedules` line proposal under D-LINE-WORKSPACE); product-decision (Income detail rules and Who reviews schedules are NOT SET, and D-RETURN is open; both hold the real transition). PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is required: this is a new Finance flow (prepare, review, return, verify) with new wording, the client has not seen it working, and it is money, so it does not merge without the design engineer.
